turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, and a client call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. And what's the basis for it, Hale?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing that down. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first, and 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in. Did you do either?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
That's a timestamp, Hale, not a finding. You still haven't answered me: did you speak to Owen before the zero went in?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. You entered a zero without calling me, so withdraw it, in writing, today.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology to Owen, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written answer, with the principal as her next stop; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one plain sentence, and she gave a flat okay, because it answered her procedure complaint directly.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing at midnight, and she refused to be a witness and went straight back to demanding the zero come off, because you had not yet answered her question about speaking to him first.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night creation time and two large edits within minutes of each other just before midnight, landed very close to that kind of night, but it proves nothing about who wrote the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you spoke to Owen before the zero went in, answer that directly and then put the 4.4 supervised reassessment on the table, instead of moving on to what he was doing at midnight.
